sources.entry: SmartPush - iOS Push Notification Debug App.

summary.one_liner: SmartPush is a macOS app for sending test iOS push notifications (APNs) using a push certificate, based on PushMeBaby.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes a Mac OS APNs tool for testing iOS push notifications. Push certificates (.cer) can be loaded by dragging a file onto the selector, picking one from a list, or browsing to a file anywhere on disk. The user enters the target device token, which differs between environments, and fills in or selects a payload. The user then picks the push environment, connects to the push server, and sends the notification. The README says the project was modified from PushMeBaby and provides Chinese-language usage steps. It includes no code, build instructions, or technical details beyond this workflow.
use_cases: test iOS push notifications during development
send APNs payloads to a device token
verify notification delivery on an iPhone
send test pushes from a Mac
stack: Objective-C (inferred from PushMeBaby base; not stated in README)
notable: Load push certificates by drag-and-drop, from a saved list, or via file browser
Choose the push environment before sending
Derived from PushMeBaby, with credit to the original author
caveats: README is brief and gives no build or install steps
Device token must be entered separately for each environment
Requires a push certificate (.cer) from the developer account
